xBRIEFInfo.description: Proposed independent learner pilot and revision scope
xBRIEFInfo.author: agent:deft-directive-setup

plan.title: Independent Learner Pilot and Curriculum Revision

narratives.Description: Run a documented pilot with representative 3Ci engineers who did not author the material, then revise the course from observed friction and ambiguity. Pilot staffing is a future activation gate and is not resolved by the organizational owner alone.
narratives.Acceptance: A named maintainer and at least two representative pilot learners are recorded. Pilot learners complete the core path and capstone using only documented instructions, hints, and solutions; undocumented human interventions and observed friction are captured; and the resulting ambiguities are corrected and revalidated before MVP exit.
narratives.Traces: PROJECT-DEFINITION Maintenance, RisksAndUnknowns; MVP independent-completion and pilot exit criteria
narratives.QualityGate: Run task deft:check separately as the aggregate merge chokepoint after the literal acceptance command; do not embed the aggregate gate in plan.acceptance.commands.

items.title: Name the maintainer and pilot cohort and define evidence capture

narrative.Acceptance: The pilot has a named content owner, at least two non-author representative learners, privacy-safe evidence capture, success criteria, and a way to record undocumented assistance.

items.title: Run the independent pilot and incorporate findings

narrative.Acceptance: Pilot evidence shows whether learners complete the capstone independently, and every material friction point is resolved, explicitly deferred, or returned to scoped work with rationale.
